title: Incremental subset-likelihood value of active SONAR score magnitudes over rank-only scores

hypothesis.null: Conditional on the prior archive, the next draw is a uniform 5-subset of 1..40; active score magnitudes add no predictive information beyond the induced rank order.
hypothesis.alternative: Within-target score gaps contain incremental information about complete 5-number subsets beyond rank order.

magnitude.utility: uS(n)=(score(n)-min_score)/(max_score-min_score); if range is zero, all utilities are zero.

rank_only.utility: uR(n)=(40-rank(n))/39, with rank 1 best and rank 40 worst.

models.normalizer: Fifth elementary symmetric polynomial by descending dynamic programming; exact normalization over C(40,5)=658008 subsets.
models.null_control: Uniform 5-of-40 subset distribution; zero log-likelihood gain.

walk_forward.information_rule: For target index t, call the exact scorer only on archive[0:t]; target t and all later draws are excluded.
walk_forward.selection: Select one temperature independently for each model using Validation mean complete-subset log-likelihood gain versus uniform; include uniform fallback; ties prefer larger temperature. Blind OOS is never used for selection.

endpoints.primary: Blind OOS paired mean log-likelihood difference: score-magnitude model minus rank-only model, at the two Validation-selected temperatures.
endpoints.secondary: Each model's log-likelihood gain versus uniform; Top5 and Top20 hit counts are descriptive only.

inference.primary_test: Paired circular block sign-flip on per-target log-likelihood differences; block length 20, 50000 replicates, one-sided alternative magnitude > rank.
inference.primary_uncertainty: Circular moving-block bootstrap 10000 replicates, block length 20, fixed seed 20261110, percentile 95% interval.
inference.multiplicity: For transparency, also compute the complete 9x9 temperature-pair family on Blind OOS and apply Holm across all 81 paired tests. The Validation-selected pair is identified separately; no Blind-based selection.
inference.model_vs_uniform: For each of 18 fixed model/temperature combinations, use a likelihood-ratio e-value against conditional uniform and Holm across 18; these are secondary.

integrity_checks: Verify source Git blob hashes against pinned main commit.
Verify 3403 unique chronological rows and valid sorted 5-of-40 outcomes.
Verify all score vectors are permutations 1..40, finite, sorted by source tie-break.
Verify every forecast is based on archive[0:t] and max training outcome index is t-1.
Verify subset partition DP against exhaustive small-n enumeration and uniform normalizer 658008.
Exhaustively sum one representative subset PMF over all 658008 subsets.
Test future-mutation invariance at nine fixed cutoffs.
Test deterministic scorer replay at eight fixed cutoffs.
Reconcile discovery/validation/historical blind target counts and ledger chronology.
Replay persisted outputs and compare exact bytes.
limitations: Historical blind OOS has been exposed to earlier SONAR research, including Q100 and Q103; it is not a virgin holdout.
The active SONAR score is heuristic, not a calibrated probability.
Q104 is a historical diagnostic; any positive result requires prospective frozen confirmation and completion of Q60.
The paired block sign-flip assumes exchangeability of contiguous 20-target block sums; bootstrap is approximate under nonstationarity.
The 81-pair Holm family is a declared sensitivity screen; it does not erase unknown analyst degrees of freedom from the wider research history.
